**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Settings
- **Only the provider you just added is suggested.** After you save an API key, WhisperShortcut now only offers to switch to that provider's models. Saving an Anthropic key, for example, no longer suggests moving dictation to Gemini.
- **German shortcut labels.** In German, Settings → General → Keyboard Shortcuts now shows "Diktieren", "Bildschirmfoto" and "Vorlesen" instead of the English names.

## Under the hood
- Updated the on-device speech engine (FluidAudio 0.18), the update framework (Sparkle 2.10.1) and Swift Collections (1.7.5).

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.73...v8.74
